risk_findings.observation: persist() injected failure after command accepted mutates room.revision + gateway receipt + Arena but does not broadcast or ACK; old checkpoint restores prior sequence
risk_findings.rust: stage full authoritative world and receipt; storage commit before mutation/broadcast

risk_findings.observation: persist() failure on first ready leaves room.ready sealed and revision ahead in memory, restart unseals; no durable ACK
risk_findings.rust: atomic ready+revision+receipt; after last ready execute turn only once, persist outcome

risk_findings.observation: persist() injected failure after playTurn() leaves executing memory, old checkpoint has preparation+first ready
risk_findings.rust: exactly once execution and checkpoint boundary with retry reconciliation

risk_findings.observation: persist() injected failure leaves gameTime advanced in memory but restart reverts
risk_findings.rust: advance/checkpoint revision and emitted SSE frame must bind to durable committed version

risk_findings.observation: writeFileSync(temp)+renameSync(file) but lacks explicit fsync file or directory; rename alone is not a full power-loss durability guarantee
risk_findings.rust: durable store/WAL, fsync ordered to supported filesystem, crash/recovery test

risk_findings.observation: legacy anonymous event visibility gap from prior A03–A12 remains; no SSE id replay
risk_findings.rust: server DTO allowlist and authenticated per-seat event cursor; no hidden state in receipts or replay

rust_transaction_contract.identity: authenticated roomId+seatId+round+requestId; derive seat from cookie, not payload
rust_transaction_contract.canonical_hash: canonical serialized enum+unitId+intent and full payload; reject requestId conflict
rust_transaction_contract.staged_validation: all actions apply to staged authoritative world, no side effects or SSE on failure
write_order: validate authenticated seat, expected round and revision
validate all actions with fog and ownership
stage complete world+event journal+receipt+ready/phase and revision
durably commit checkpoint/WAL, with appropriate fsync and atomic metadata
emit per-seat filtered SSE snapshot and return ACK
rust_transaction_contract.failure_before_commit: old state, old revision, no leaked event or receipt, retry may apply exactly once
rust_transaction_contract.failure_after_commit_before_ack: read durable receipt by same idempotency key and return original ACK; never re-execute
rust_transaction_contract.restart: replay WAL/committed checkpoint only; reject partial/temp/corrupt images with verified recovery and integrity
rust_transaction_contract.privacy: receipt only to authenticated seat; SSE team-filtered state/event DTO; never send raw tokenHash, privateSeed, RNG, hidden positions/wards, other seat draft
rust_transaction_contract.caveats: The Node QA store assumes single writer; fixed room ID, toy order.stop/ready subset, SHA256 of noncanonical JSON.stringify, no actual authentication, no WAL, no process kill. NOT a production implementation.
